acceptance_criteria.statement: The film surface distance minus the camera chord equals the predicted chord-geodesic gap for every marker pair
acceptance_criteria.test: E_n <= 1 with U_m = 2 sqrt(u_film^2 + u_pair^2) = 0.1149 mm (film 0.05 mm, camera pair 0.0283 mm) and U_p = 2 |d gap / dR| u_R, u_R = 0.1 / sqrt(3) mm (the T140 radius term)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Separation of offset helices is the flat-plate separation
acceptance_criteria.test: fit slope and intercept of the 3D distances between the two tape centrelines (their difference from the surface separation is below 1e-4 mm at 2 mm on R = 100 mm); compare with the flat-plate control T126

acceptance_criteria.statement: The camera chord alone differs from the predicted geodesic distance for circumferential pairs of 30 deg and more (the extrinsic signature)
acceptance_criteria.test: |chord - geodesic| / sqrt((2 u_pair)^2 + (2 |d chord / dR| u_R)^2) > 1; separations below the T127 resolvable arc (23.9 mm with the camera) are not tested

predicted_quantities.quantity: Jacobi transfer along a 45 deg helix of 300 mm

procedure.action: Soak the specimen and its holder for 4 h at 20 +/- 1 C; log air and part temperature every 10 min.
outputs: environment log with an explicit UTC offset

procedure.action: Check the instruments before the acquisition: the camera images SB-1000; the tracker measures the SB-1000 end points with its SMR; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points; the film is read against the SG-200 steps at 50, 100 and 150 mm. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Lay the tube in VB-01 (V-block pair) with the end face against the end stop and the axial scribe B facing straight up, away from the vees; clamp; probe datum A with the CMM at phi = -75, -15, 45, 75 deg from scribe B on each marker ring (between markers), scribe B at z = 40 and 260 mm and end face C at 3 points; fit the axis A (fit_cylinder), record the fitted radius and the roundness of each ring over the probed arc (peak to valley of the radial residuals), and build the PART frame (datum_frame_axis).
procedure.check: every ring's roundness is at most the declared form tolerance 0.1 mm plus 2 U of the CMM (0.108 mm); otherwise stop and record the tube as outside the cylinder model (seam weld and out-of-roundness are not modelled); re-seating does not change the form

procedure.action: Measure the four datum targets of VB-01 (a 1.5 in SMR seated on each) with the tracker to register FIXTURE in WORLD (frame chain).
outputs: WORLD -> FIXTURE transform and its covariance

procedure.action: Measure the 21 markers on the upper half of the three rings (within 90 deg of scribe B) with the camera (SB-1000 and the VB-01 datum targets in every image set) and the tracker; export the camera coordinates as the photogrammetry capture. The lower markers face into the vees and the table and are not measured.

Lay the film gauge from marker centre to marker centre of each of the ten marker pairs (all on the upper half) without tension or in-plane steering, read the surface distance under a 10x loupe, and export the readings as the film capture.
procedure.check: two readings per pair agree within 2 x 0.05 mm; otherwise re-lay the film

procedure.action: Repeat steps 3, 5 and 6 twice more, removing the specimen from VB-01 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of the datum, marker and film measurements).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of the datum, marker and film measurements)

procedure.action: Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape HX45; lay tape HX45 from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape HX45: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape HX45 with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows HX45-S0 and HX45-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows HX45-S0 and HX45-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape HX45 every 30 mm of arclength from s = 0 to 300 mm.
Measure the targets on tape HX45 with the camera, with SB-1000 and the VB-01 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; retain their coordinates (no task reads them yet).
Repeat steps 3, 9 and 11 twice more, removing the specimen from VB-01 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape HX45; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape HX45; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape HX45.

Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape HX45-L2; lay tape HX45-L2 from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape HX45-L2: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape HX45-L2 with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows HX45-L2-S0 and HX45-L2-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows HX45-L2-S0 and HX45-L2-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape HX45-L2 every 30 mm of arclength from s = 0 to 300 mm.
Measure the targets on tape HX45-L2 with the camera, with SB-1000 and the VB-01 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; retain their coordinates (no task reads them yet).
Repeat steps 3, 15 and 17 twice more, removing the specimen from VB-01 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape HX45-L2; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape HX45-L2; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape HX45-L2.

Check the instruments after the acquisition: the camera images SB-1000; the tracker measures the SB-1000 end points with its SMR; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points; the film is read against the SG-200 steps at 50, 100 and 150 mm. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Retain every raw file, replicate and instrument check with its T139 retention record (ciw.lab-measurement-retention.v1).
outputs: retained raw data and retention records

purpose: Separate extrinsic effects (chord vs geodesic) from intrinsic ones (Jacobi separation), which must match the flat plate.

specimen.seam_weld: along phi = 180 deg, opposite scribe B: it faces down between the vee contact lines (not modelled)

tape_layout.rules: tapes on the specimen together: centrelines at least a tape width plus a target diameter apart; slots used in one laying: at least one slot width apart; every tape centreline clears each specimen marker and datum probe point by half the wider of tape and target plus half a marker (manufacturing_records._tape_layout, on the predicted centrelines)
tape_layout.sequence: one tape on the specimen at a time: seat the start jig with that tape's insert, lay the tape, remove the jig, measure the tape and its targets (with re-seated replicates) and remove them before the next tape is laid; every tape is measured in the PART frame of the specimen's own datums
